text:
mira_csm: Heads-up — Embarkade (renewal in ~6w) showing rising tail latencies on chat endpoints after demo traffic. I ran a quick perf sweep and have a low-risk plan to reduce token cost and P95 without disrupting UX.

drew_ml: share numbers and proposed tradeoffs?

mira_csm: quick perf summary: 
```
baseline: model=redwood-open-13b | qps=60
p50=48ms  p95=420ms
cost/token=$0.0012
observed anomalies on sequences >512 tokens (batching pressure)
```
Plan (high level): 1) enable mixed-precision quant candidate (6-bit) for 13b, 2) route long sequences to compact 7b with prefix/KV cache, 3) canary 5% -> 25% rollout if metrics hold.

alex_eng: high-level sounds good. curious about eval/QA impact and the rollback story.

drew_ml: ran quick eval on 120 prod-like prompts (intent + long context). summary: 6-bit shows small quality delta. numbers: accuracy 92.1% -> 91.5% (avg drop ~0.6%), hallucination score unchanged. latency sim: 
```
13b-int8: p95=180ms p50=40ms
13b-6bit: p95=210ms p50=45ms
7b-compact: p95=140ms p50=35ms
```
Cost delta: ~-38% when routing long tails to 7b and using 6-bit for short prompts.

jordan_cs: customer is sensitive to hallucinations; they'll tolerate tiny QA drop if we keep deterministic fallback. Did we test fallbacks?

mira_csm: yes — proposed fallback policy: if compact7b confidence < 0.80 then route to 13b-int6 (slower/costly but higher quality). Also keep request-level logging for first 7 days (sampled 10%).

opsbot: deploybot created canary: canary/embarkade/quant-routing-v1 @ 2751112230 :rocket: (5% traffic)

alex_eng: draft routing policy (will push as a config):
```yaml
policy: embarkade-longseq-routing
match:
  - header: x-seq-len
    operator: '>'
    value: 512
actions:
  - route: redwood-7b-compact
    percent: 5
  - fallback:
      route: redwood-open-13b-int6
      confidence_threshold: 0.8
    percent: 95
observability:
  sample_rate: 0.1
  eval_set: s3://redwood-evals/embarkade/quant120.csv
```

mira_csm: action items: 
- drew_ml: run the 120-prompt eval + smoke tests, report deltas by EOD tomorrow
- alex_eng: deploy routing policy, ensure canary logging + automatic rollback if p95 increases >15% or hallucination delta >2%
- jordan_cs: confirm Fri 10am PT enablement session with Embarkade and get acceptance from product owner

drew_ml: ack — i'll upload raw evals and a short diff report to Drive: https://drive.redwood/embarkade/quant-eval (will mark redbox if anything surprising)

jordan_cs: locking Fri 10am PT, sending invite now. will include a short slide with rollback plan.

mira_csm: TL;DR: low-risk cost win, canary live 5%, fallback in place, enablement scheduled. If no objections by EOD I'll promote canary to 24h run and start the 5% canary metrics watch. :thumbsup:

alex_eng: +1 from infra side. I'll add the rollback hook (auto-deploy revert) in the pipeline.

drew_ml: +1 from ML. I'll flag any distributional drift quickly.

jordan_cs: +1 from CS — will keep customer looped in.

mira_csm: thanks team — will update this thread with the 24h snapshot and next steps.
